title: The skills and the kb-worker agent ask the _self route instead of reading sections, with a measured before and after
goal: Every skill under .claude/skills/ that read kb/_self sections up front and .claude/agents/kb-worker.md read only maintaining's Conduct for changes with selfdoc.py section and get every other rule by asking python3 _tools/rag.py pack --root _self (kb-item, kb-sprint and kb-worker also once with --item ID for the item's brief), each naming the questions its steps need; no heading is renamed; and kb/_self/reports/2026-10-06-self-rules-retrieval.md records, taken the same way before and after, the bytes each skill's up-front reading prints and a headless session's tokens, tool calls, wall time and graded answers on one fixed set of rule questions

run: import glob,shlex,sys; bad=[f for f in glob.glob('.claude/skills/*/SKILL.md')+['.claude/agents/kb-worker.md'] for l in open(f,encoding='utf-8') if l.strip().startswith('python3 _tools/selfdoc.py section') and len(shlex.split(l.strip()))>5]; print(bad); sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)
